# infisical_cert_manager_external_ca_digicert (Resource)

Create and manage external DigiCert (CertCentral) certificate authorities in Certificate Manager. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host          = "https://app.infisical.com"
  client_id     = var.client_id
  client_secret = var.client_secret
}

resource "infisical_app_connection_digicert" "digicert" {
  name   = "digicert-connection"
  method = "api-key"
  credentials = {
    api_key = var.digicert_api_key
    region  = "us"
  }
}

# Issues SSL/TLS certificates
resource "infisical_cert_manager_external_ca_digicert" "ssl" {
  name   = "digicert-ssl"
  status = "active"

  app_connection_id = infisical_app_connection_digicert.digicert.id
  organization_id   = 123456
  product_name_id   = "ssl_plus"
  purpose           = "ssl"
}

# Issues code signing certificates, which require a verified contact
resource "infisical_cert_manager_external_ca_digicert" "code_signing" {
  name   = "digicert-code-signing"
  status = "active"

  app_connection_id = infisical_app_connection_digicert.digicert.id
  organization_id   = 123456
  product_name_id   = "code_signing"
  purpose           = "code_signing"

  verified_contact = {
    first_name = "Jane"
    last_name  = "Doe"
    email      = "jane.doe@example.com"
    job_title  = "Security Engineer"
    telephone  = "+1-555-000-0000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_connection_id` (String) The ID of the DigiCert app connection used for certificate issuance
- `name` (String) The name of the DigiCert CA
- `organization_id` (Number) The CertCentral organization ID that will be listed on issued certificates
- `product_name_id` (String) The DigiCert product name ID used for issuance (e.g. ssl_plus, code_signing, code_signing_ev)

### Optional

- `purpose` (String) Whether this CA issues SSL/TLS or code signing certificates. Supported values: ssl, code_signing. Defaults to 'ssl'.
- `status` (String) The status of the CA. Supported values: active, disabled. Defaults to 'active'.
- `verified_contact` (Attributes) Contact info for the user who approves first-time code signing orders for the organization. Required when purpose is 'code_signing'. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verified_contact))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the DigiCert CA

<a id="nestedatt--verified_contact"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verified_contact`

Required:

- `email` (String) The email address of the verified contact
- `first_name` (String) The first name of the verified contact
- `job_title` (String) The job title of the verified contact
- `last_name` (String) The last name of the verified contact
- `telephone` (String) The telephone number of the verified contact

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the external DigiCert CA by its ID
terraform import infisical_cert_manager_external_ca_digicert.example <ca_id>
```
